heroic-strike.d: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 157 and causes a high amount of threat.

charge.meta: Level 46 · 25 yd range · Instant · 15 sec cooldown
charge.q: Requires Battle Stance (or Defensive Stance with Vanguard)
charge.d: Charge an enemy, generate 15 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec. Cannot be used in combat.

rend.d: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 147 damage over 21 sec.

thunder-clap.d: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder, increasing the time between their attacks by 20% for 30 sec and doing 103 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

hamstring.d: Maims the enemy, causing 45 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 50% for 15 sec.

overpower.meta: Level 60 · 5 Rage / 1 Happiness · Melee Range · Instant · 5 sec cooldown
overpower.d: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 35. Only useable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

tactical-mastery.d: You retain up to 10 Rage when you change Stances.

mocking-blow.meta: Level 56 · 10 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 2 min cooldown
mocking-blow.d: A mocking attack that causes 93 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

retaliation.d: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked. A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

victory-rush.meta: Level 20 · Melee Range · Instant · 30 sec cooldown
victory-rush.d: Instantly attack the target causing (1 + 15% of Attack Power) damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health. Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.

mortal-strike.meta: Level 60 · 30 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
mortal-strike.d: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 160 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

battle-shout.d: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 139. Lasts 3 min.

demoralizing-shout.d: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 204 for 45 sec.

cleave.d: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

slam.meta: Level 54 · 15 Rage · Melee Range · 1.5 sec cast · 15 sec cooldown
slam.d: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 87.

intimidating-shout.meta: Level 22 · 25 Rage · 10 yd range · Instant · 3 min cooldown
intimidating-shout.d: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

execute.d: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 600 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 15 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

challenging-shout.d: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

berserker-rage.d: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

berserker-stance.d: An aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%.

intercept.meta: Level 52 · 10 Rage · 25 yd range · Instant · 30 sec cooldown
intercept.d: Charge an enemy, causing 65 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

whirlwind.d: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.

pummel.meta: Level 58 · 10 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 10 sec cooldown
pummel.d: Pummel the target for 50 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

bloodthirst.meta: Level 60 · 30 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
bloodthirst.d: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 48 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

recklessness.d: The warrior will gain 100% increased critical strike chance and will be immune to Fear effects for the next 15 sec, but all damage taken is increased by 20%.

bloodrage.meta: Level 10 · 20% of base health · Instant · 1 min cooldown
bloodrage.d: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

defensive-stance.d: A defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 80%.

sunder-armor.d: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 450 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

taunt.meta: Level 10 · Melee Range · Instant · 8 sec cooldown
taunt.d: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

shield-bash.meta: Level 52 · 10 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 12 sec cooldown
shield-bash.d: Bashes the target with your shield for 45 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

revenge.meta: Level 60 · 5 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 5 sec cooldown
revenge.d: Instantly counterattack an enemy for (138 + 22.5% of Attack Power) to (168 + 22.5% of Attack Power) damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

shield-block.d: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

disarm.meta: Level 18 · 20 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 1 min cooldown
disarm.d: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

shield-wall.d: Reduces the damage taken from all attacks by 60% for 12 sec.

shield-slam.meta: Level 60 · 20 Rage · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown
shield-slam.d: Slam the target with your shield, causing 640 to 670 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
